svg.title: Figure 01 · Option payoffs and financed terminal profit
svg.desc: K = 100, S₀ = 100, r = 5%, q = 0, σ = 20%, τ = 1 year. Profit subtracts the premium grown to maturity; the two break-even spots are therefore not simply the strike.
